Neuron, layer and MLP classes with tanh nonlinearity
Same machinery reproduced in PyTorch for comparison
Two-layer MLP forward pass, predictions and loss components
Gradient descent tuning until outputs match targets

teaches.why: Applies the chain rule backwards through nodes and verifies with gradient checks.
Defines neuron, layer and multilayer perceptron classes in code.

Iteratively tunes weights by gradient descent toward the targets.
